resolution: Fixed: /test (F2 walk mode) had NO collision — walk through walls, fall through floors. Root cause found via headless diagnostic on the user's real map: the liftedPieces terrain-lift in PlayRoute. It was authored (req_0444) against state.world, but state was the WorldStreamState (no .world), so liftToTerrain silently ran on undefined → NaN → a harmless no-op since req_0444. The crash fix (req_0541) repointed it to props.state.world, which made the lift ACTUALLY run for the first time — but props.state is the STATIC GameState with no painted terrain (paint lives in the build stream), so groundColumnTop returns 0 under all 4390 pieces and liftToTerrain DROPPED buildings onto y=0, moving 3537 pieces >5m (max 47.8m). Render+colliders move together, so buildings render where you see them but collide ~48m away → total walk-through. Fix: disable the lift here (liftedPieces = pieces); buildings collide where the user authored them, restoring the pre-crash working behavior. Proper F2 terrain-padding needs the live painted world (embodied worldGrid, defined below) — left as a separate tracked change, not faked. TSX hot-reloads; no rebuild. groundColumnTop still used elsewhere with worldGrid.
